items.statement: The validated LS metal-centered features overlap the ligand fluorescence-relevant window and support the proposed nonradiative energy-transfer interpretation within the truncated model.
items.expected: A final conclusion links the approximately 400 and 545–550 nm metal-centered features to spectral overlap and possible fluorescence quenching, while distinguishing model interpretation from a directly computed rate.

items.statement: Interpretation is bounded by the isolated truncated model and vertical TD-DFT approximation.
items.expected: Limitations explicitly mention truncation and that spectral overlap is not itself a periodic solid-state dynamical rate.
